title: 5. A agressão emocional da mulher contra o homem

queries.text: Numbered "5." in the original, although the previous chapter is also "5." and the table of contents lists this one as 6. Kept as in the original (see known_issues).
"inferno astral" (Brazilian astrological expression for a period of bad luck; here simply "torment") rendered "sheer hell".
